entries.name: Feast of Blood
entries: When you drain blood with your Bloodthirst ability, you experience a surge of vitality. Your speed increases by 10 feet, and you gain advantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and saving throws for 1 minute.

texts.fr: Les vampires ne mûrissent et ne vieillissent pas de la même manière que les autres races.
Les vampires n’ont peut-être pas de tendance innée au mal, mais beaucoup finissent par y succomber. Mauvais ou non, leurs hiérarchies strictes les inclinent vers un alignement loyal.
Les vampires ont la même taille et la même corpulence que les humains. Ta catégorie de taille est Moyenne.

Quand tu draines du sang avec ton aptitude Soif de sang, tu ressens un afflux de vitalité. Ta vitesse augmente de 10 pieds, et tu bénéficies de l’avantage aux tests et aux jets de sauvegarde de Force et de Dextérité pendant 1 minute.
Tu sais parler, lire et écrire le {@language Common Trade Pidgin|PSX|Common}, s’il existe dans ta campagne, et le {@language Vampire|PSX}.

entries.name: Blood Thirst
entries: You can drain blood and life energy from a willing creature, or one that is {@condition grappled} by you, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. Make a melee attack against the target. If you hit, you deal 1 piercing damage and {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and you regain hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

entries.name: Age
entries: Although elves reach physical maturity at about the same age as humans, the elven understanding of adulthood goes beyond physical growth to encompass worldly experience. An elf typically claims adulthood and an adult name around the age of 100 and can live to be 750 years old.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Elves love freedom, variety, and self-expression, so they lean strongly toward the gentler aspects of chaos. They value and protect others' freedom as well as their own, and they are more often good than not.

entries.name: Size
entries: Elves range from under 5 to over 6 feet tall and have slender builds. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Age
entries: Vampires don't mature and age in the same way that other races do. Every living vampire is either a bloodchief, infected by Ulamog's influence in the distant reaches of history, or was spawned by a bloodchief from a living human. Most vampires are thus very old, but few have any memory of their earliest years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Vampires have no innate tendency toward evil, but consuming the life energy of other creatures often pushes them to that end. Regardless of their moral bent, the strict hierarchies of their bloodchiefs inclines them toward a lawful alignment.

entries.name: Size
entries: Vampires are about the same size and build as humans. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Blood Thirst
entries: You can drain blood and life energy from a willing creature, or one that is {@condition grappled} by you, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. Make a melee attack against the target. If you hit, you deal 1 piercing damage and {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and you regain hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

entries.name: Age
entries: Deep gnomes are short-lived for gnomes. They mature at the same rate humans do and are considered full-grown adults by 25. They live 200 to 250 years, although hard toil and the dangers of the Underdark often claim them before their time.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Svirfneblin believe that survival depends on avoiding entanglements with other creatures and not making enemies, so they favor neutral alignments. They rarely wish others ill, and they are unlikely to take risks on behalf of others.

entries.name: Size
entries: A typical svirfneblin stands about 3 to 3½ feet tall and weighs 80 to 120 pounds. Your size is Small.

entries.name: Superior Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: You have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to hide in rocky terrain.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common, Gnomish, and Undercommon. The svirfneblin dialect is more guttural than surface Gnomish, and most svirfneblin know only a little bit of Common, but those who deal with outsiders (and that includes you as an adventurer) pick up enough Common to get by in other lands.

texts.fr: Les gnomes des profondeurs vivent peu pour des gnomes. Ils mûrissent au même rythme que les humains et sont considérés comme adultes pleinement développés à 25 ans. Ils vivent de 200 à 250 ans, mais le labeur et les dangers de l’Outreterre les emportent souvent avant l’heure.

Les svirfnebelins pensent que survivre exige d’éviter les complications avec les autres créatures et de ne pas se faire d’ennemis ; ils préfèrent donc les alignements neutres. Ils souhaitent rarement du mal et prennent peu de risques pour autrui.
Un svirfnebelin typique mesure environ 3 à 3½ pieds et pèse de 80 à 120 livres. Tu es de taille P.

Habitué à la vie souterraine, tu possèdes une vision supérieure dans l’obscurité et la lumière faible. Tu vois à 120 pieds dans une lumière faible comme dans une lumière vive, et dans les ténèbres comme dans une lumière faible. Tu ne distingues pas les couleurs dans les ténèbres, seulement des nuances de gris.
Tu bénéficies d’un avantage aux tests de Dextérité ({@skill Stealth}) pour te cacher sur un terrain rocheux.

Tu sais parler, lire et écrire le commun, le gnome et le commun des profondeurs. Le dialecte svirfnebelin est plus guttural que le gnome de surface, et la plupart ne connaissent qu’un peu de commun, mais ceux qui traitent avec les étrangers, dont toi comme aventurier, en apprennent assez pour se débrouiller ailleurs.

entries.name: Gnome Cunning
entries: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common, Gnomish, and Undercommon. The svirfneblin dialect is more guttural than surface Gnomish, and most svirfneblin know only a little bit of Common, but those who deal with outsiders (and that includes you as an adventurer) pick up enough Common to get by in other lands.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Svirfneblin believe that survival depends on avoiding entanglements with other creatures and not making enemies, so they favor neutral alignments. They rarely wish others ill, and they are unlikely to take risks on behalf of others.

entries.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: You have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to hide in rocky terrain.

entries.name: Silent Speech
entries: You can speak telepathically to any creature within 30 feet of you. The creature understands you only if the two of you share a language. You can speak telepathically in this way to one creature at a time.

entries.name: Age
entries: A halfling reaches adulthood at the age of 20 and generally lives into the middle of his or her second century.

entries.name: Size
entries: Halflings average about 3 feet tall and weigh about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.

entries.name: Lucky
entries: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

entries.name: Brave
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

entries.name: Halfling Nimbleness
entries: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Halfling. The Halfling language isn't secret, but halflings are loath to share it with others. They write very little, so they don't have a rich body of literature. Their oral tradition, however, is very strong. Almost all halflings speak Common to converse with the people in whose lands they dwell or through which they are traveling.

entries.name: Age
entries: Half-elves mature at the same rate humans do and reach adulthood around the age of 20. They live much longer than humans, however, often exceeding 180 years.

entries.name: Size
entries: Half-elves are about the same size as humans, ranging from 5 to 6 feet tall. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Thanks to your elf blood, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put you to sleep.

entries: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

entries: You gain a swimming speed of 30 ft.
